sources.n_shots: Number of overlaid shots (the epic asks for 10 runs).
sources.seed: Seed of numpy.random.default_rng; the same seed always gives the same shots.
sources.club_roll_sd_deg: First illustrative value, not a measurement: 0.5 degree standard deviation of the club roll in the hands, to be replaced by measured grip repeatability. On the matched driver swing the side changes about 6.6 m per degree of roll.
sources.ball_position_sd_m: First illustrative value, not a measurement: 5 mm standard deviation of the ball position along the target line, to be replaced by measured setup repeatability. The face turns about 0.5 degree per centimetre of ball position.
sources.base_club_roll_deg: Mean club roll in the hands (degrees) the random variation is added to; 0 replays the matched swing as measured.
sources.base_ball_shift_m: Mean ball shift along the target line (metres, positive toward the target) the random variation is added to.
sources.ellipse_sigma: Ellipse of the landing points drawn at this many standard deviations (1 = one sigma, from the sample covariance).
sources.min_points_for_ellipse: A covariance needs at least three landing points to be a meaningful ellipse; fewer draw no ellipse.
sources.plot: Presentation only: colours, sizes and resolution of the dispersion figure; margin_fraction pads the plan and profile limits; the zoom panel shows only the landing points at equal scale (zoom_margin_fraction of their spread, at least zoom_min_half_width_m) so the ellipse is readable.

plot.title: Shot Dispersion from Small Random Variations
